answer: Like a living mycelium weaving through dark soil, our decentralized network crystallizes trust through transitive trust-decay paths. Each genuine peer’s reputation forms an iridescent opal of verified history. When a rogue swarm attempts a forged voyage to flood consensus, every ungrounded synthetic identity merely returns a fading echo that triggers superlinear staking slashing. Because valid quorum weight requires multi-hop cryptographic endorsements that scale with exponential attacker cost, counterfeit replicas starve before penetrating the core canopy.
